- Triage 6635414689 folded this card into #30075 ("The `domain:ui` seat folds it into #30075's PR and closes this card as a duplicate there"). #30075 is now closed (completed) and its seat `domain:ui#3` has gone off duty without closing this card.
- On `origin/main`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:565` draws `componentNode('record:path', { statusField, stages, allowStageChange: true })` (commit `5fa9375ec`, PR #30221: "the default record page lets an editor advance the stage from the path"). So an author no longer has to write a whole page to get stage press on the default record page, which is this card's Expected.
- Asked triage to close it as a duplicate of #30075 (lanes do not self-close).
